sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Good afternoon.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Thank you for calling Justice Federal Credit Union.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Hello there, I'm Jeffrey.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I actually contacted you guys to know if you guys hand out loans.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Oh, hi, Jeffrey.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I certainly appreciate you giving us a call today.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And yes, we do offer various consumer loans.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Can I ask a little bit about a little bit of questions to you about what type of loan you may be seeking?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Are you interested in a personal loan, a business loan, a commercial loan, or an agricultural loan?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Well, it's got to be agricultural.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: You see I have this farm and basically I'm looking to buy some equipment.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Great.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So you're looking to expand your current operation.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, exactly.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So what do I need to be doing to get a loan for these equipment?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: First, let me go ahead and ask a few qualifying questions if you don't mind.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Sure, go ahead.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Now, do you currently have an account with us?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I do not think I do.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, not a problem.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And how long has your farm been in operation?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: It's been about three months.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And was it a running farm prior to you taking it over, or is it a completely new venture for you?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: No, yes, my grandfather owned it but after he passed away I took over ownership.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: He left it to me.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So I took over the business with things he already had and it sounds good.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So I'm looking to really expand my selection of tools and supplies to help improve.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So basically, it's been a running farm for several years, but you have had ownership of it for the last three months, correct?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That's right.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And the previous owner, did he have an account with us?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: He probably did.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: His name is Michael Thompson.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, I'll go ahead and note that down.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, great.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And what type of equipment are you looking to get a loan for?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: What is the amount?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Is it under 10 ,000 or over 10 ,000?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I would imagine it's over.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I'm looking to buy like most of the things that we have on the farm are old so I'm looking to replace everything that would range from tractors to plows and all sorts of machines.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, great.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Now, do you have any collateral that you will be using as part of your loan application?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Well, you see this is my first time taking a loan so I don't really know much about it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Bicolateral, what do you mean?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, I would be happy to explain this to you.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Collateral is basically something that you would be using as security against the repayment of your loan.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: For example, if you're a homeowner, or if you own land, or any other type of property, then that could be used as collateral as a basis for your loan.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So for example, this is just an example, not for your specific case.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Say you wanted to borrow $50 ,000, and you use your home as collateral.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So we would put a lien against your home in the event that you did not repay the balance.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: But of course, if you make your payments on time, and you pay off the balance before, then that lien would be revoked.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: In the event that you did not pay, of course, we would be able to file an injunction so that anytime you refinance your home or sold that property, then we would be able to recoup our payment at that time.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: That is just an example.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: For smaller loan amounts, you would necessarily need collateral, but you would have to show that you have good credit, and that you have been using credit responsibly, and also that you have a regular source of income.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Say from a regular job, like a salary job, or if you're a W2N4E, we would need at least 12 -month bank statement that shows that you're financially solvent and that you actually have the ability to make payments on the loan amount that you are seeking.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Great.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I see.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That's a lot of information but I get it now.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So you sit here thinking about borrowing about $10 ,000 for the purpose of purchasing new equipment to help maintain the farm that your grandfather left behind.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, great.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Not a problem.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And are you currently working?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, I am working actually.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I have another company of my own that I work at.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So it's your own company, so make sure you're self -employed, or are you working for someone else?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I am self -employed, yes.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And what is your monthly income?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Approximate?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That'll be approximately, I'd say about $1 ,200 per

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: $1 ,200 per month?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: month, yes.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: On an average,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, thank you so much.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I didn't send information in.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Do you have a mortgage, or are you renting friendly?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I am currently renting.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, and what is your monthly rent?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That would be around $700.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And do you have any other expenses that I should know about?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Currently, no.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: thank you.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, I just put all that information in there. I

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: have an idea of what your credit score may be.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I haven't checked it recently but it should be around $400, I believe.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, thank you, information.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And is there anyone who would be able to be a cold borrower on this loan?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I could ask my wife.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, it would be my wife.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Thank you. Okay,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: based on the information you have provided for me, it is not likely that we would be able to extend a loan to you at this time, mainly for a few reasons, which I will explain to you.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: We do need a minimum credit score of $650 for any loan that we offer through our credit union here.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And for a loan $10 ,000 or more, you would need at least a $4 ,000 monthly income in order to qualify.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And with your $400 credit and your $1 ,200 a month income, which also, which most of it goes towards your living, you would not, according to our calculations, you would not be able to make payments on a loan at this time.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I see.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: What I can do is send you some information to help you get your credit in order and some budgeting tips that may help you to get on a better path towards financial solvency so you can reply maybe six months or one year down the line. You

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I see.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: No, that won't be necessary.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you for all your time.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: are most welcome and do feel free to give us a call anytime.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, of course.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Goodbye.
